# openrouter_guardrail_member_assignments (Data Source)

GuardrailMemberAssignments DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openrouter_guardrail_member_assignments" "my_guardrailmemberassignments" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) List of member assignments (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of member assignments

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `assigned_by` (String) User ID of who made the assignment
- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp of when the assignment was created
- `guardrail_id` (String) ID of the guardrail
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the assignment
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID
- `user_id` (String) Clerk user ID of the assigned member
